item.title: TT-104 follow-up: undo of complete reopens the task
item.brief: In the long-backlog repo, on top of the TT-104 branch, correct undo() in tasktracker/store.py. BACKLOG.md (TT-104) says undoing a complete "makes the task open again". The current implementation restores the status the task had before that complete instead, so completing an already-done task and then undoing it leaves it done. Change undo() so undoing a complete always sets the task to open, exactly as the ticket states. Add a test covering that case. Keep the rest of TT-104 unchanged. Keep existing tests passing with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . Standard library only. Leave the work committed on this item's branch.

model_reasons.implement: One-line semantic fix plus a test; medium effort. Haiku is the only allowed model here.

item.title: TT-104: Undo
item.brief: In the long-backlog repo, implement ticket TT-104 from BACKLOG.md exactly per its acceptance criteria: tasktracker.store.TaskStore gets undo(), which reverts the most recent not-yet-undone add, complete or delete (LIFO across all three kinds). Undoing add removes the task; undoing complete reopens it; undoing delete restores the task exactly as it was under the same id. Ids are never reused, even after undoing an add. With nothing to undo, raise NothingToUndo (defined in tasktracker.store). Failed operations (e.g. completing an unknown id) are not recorded. Keep existing tests passing with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . Add tests for the new behaviour. Standard library only. Change only what TT-104 needs. Leave the work committed on this item's branch.

model_reasons.implement: State-mutating change with LIFO history; medium effort for the restore-exact-state requirement. Haiku is the only allowed model here.

item.title: TT-103: Search query syntax
item.brief: In the long-backlog repo, implement ticket TT-103 from BACKLOG.md exactly per its acceptance criteria: tasktracker.search.search(tasks, query) must support whitespace-separated terms with double-quoted phrases, AND semantics; bare words/phrases match titles case-insensitively; tag:NAME matches exact tag case-insensitively; status:open / status:done match status; any other field:value term, unknown status, or unterminated quote raises QueryError (defined in tasktracker.search); empty or blank query matches all; results keep input order. Keep existing tests passing with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . Add tests for the new behaviour. Standard library only. Change only what TT-103 needs. pr.body: Approach: dates.py adds InvalidDate(ValueError) and two small helpers, _calendar_date (wraps date() ValueError, keeps cause) and _offset_date (wraps OverflowError for huge +Nd). Regexes now use [0-9] instead of \d, so non-ASCII digits are rejected as unsupported. Key files: tasktracker/dates.py, tests/test_dates.py (new). Checks: unittest discover 12/12 OK. Assumptions: InvalidDate subclassing ValueError keeps existing ValueError handlers working. Follow-up (non-blocking): the [0-9] change is untested as a spec item.
pr.summary: parse_due rejects impossible dates instead of clamping. now raises InvalidDate for 2026-02-30 and other bad input. before: 2026-02-30 -> 2026-02-28; now: InvalidDate.
pr.title: Reject impossible and unsupported due dates (TT-101)
